title: Artifact direction picker: contract journey
description: A code-review walkthrough of how VAR asks for direction, binds it to creation, and keeps the extension-only value out of persisted artifact JSON.

guards.evidence: create_visual_artifact is blocked until the picker returns a non-empty instruction.
directionInstruction must exactly match the selected instruction.
The picker returns a cancelled result; the agent must ask in chat instead.
artifactSpecFromParams removes directionInstruction before CLI creation.

props.content: This change turns a visual-artifact request into an explicit user contract: choose a direction first, carry that exact instruction into creation, then strip it before the JSON artifact is saved.

props.body: The change prevents silent direction drift at the extension boundary. It does not try to mechanically judge page aesthetics; it guarantees that creation is tied to the user-selected instruction.
props.title: Review conclusion

items.note: The active Pi guidance requires a direction choice before source inspection or spec construction.
choose_visual_artifact_direction opens Pi UI, includes an Other path, and receives the agent abort signal.
Only a non-cancelled selection with a non-blank instruction becomes the current request direction.
create_visual_artifact must carry the exact selected text as directionInstruction or the tool call is blocked.

items.text: CLI receives a clean artifact spec
items.note: directionInstruction is extension metadata and is removed before validation, storage, and optional publishing.
